# Independent Q24 review: declared-language result and current native scope

2026-10-14. Reviewer `EM-NONAUTHOR-5DF3A9B6`, continuing own activity
`RA-MATH-NONAUTHOR-5DF3A9B61C7D4BE6BEE0`. Directed NONBLIND mathematical
and semantic support. This is not a Native DR, intake decision, acceptance,
P000 amendment or parent-objective completion. Root retains formal Driver
and Source responsibilities. No original scientific file is modified.

Exact historical object: `RR-1DE3F3213271AED2625C`, Task
`RS-P000-PHILOSOPHY-FIRST-NATIVE-MODEL-CHANGE-ARROW-AUDIT`, publication
`TP2-299847960EBDCF2A0846`, scientific author `EM-P000-79C223`.
The seven complete originals are pinned at Source
`07b3ce31038a2514508b17f56954032587895537`. The return is10046 bytes,
SHA256 `8a4c9fa3e7a795734b7a9b7df3491f89820d5d133f0e1496cdea5623d6882fe1`,
Git blob `c3f025fd2cffe2f84f38b139e46278b22f4cb9e2`.

**Disposition: BOUNDED PASS for the explicitly frozen nine-candidate
language audit and the absence of a newly supplied arrow justifying
escalation of the Q18/Q21 finite hidden-coupling transport line.**
The observer/type distinctions and the finite fiber calculation are valid
at their declared strength. The following stronger reading is **not
established and must not be accepted**: all nonautomorphism or noninvertible
model/state updates definable or derivable in the whole current P000
native theory are absent. The required current interpretation restrictions
in Sections3,6,8 below are part of this disposition.

This bounded result meets the original Task's frozen-candidate negative
alternative for that finite declared language, especially the slice/readout
distinction and lack of a new Q18 change arrow. It does not close a broader
current-native arrow-existence question, the rotation/time-law research
program or the parent Objective. If a formal disposition is intended to
assert that broader hard target, it needs further work and cannot use this
review as its evidence. Queue closure is not a reason to enlarge the result.

## 1. Exact inputs, identity and independence

I read all seven original files: Taskbook, return, certificate, checker
source, RR, ER and publication. This packet has one machine certificate;
its frozen_language/model_change_gate fields are the task-local contract.
There is no separate effect contract file to infer. The seven byte counts,
SHA256 values and Git blobs match the existing Source07b3 difference
report. The RR's four output pins match ER, checker, certificate and return.
The canonical ER and publication bind the same Taskbook blob.

I additionally fetched through connected GitHub at immutable commit
`04c7aac0aa4d0b0125901293d5ab063311aa1edd` the current P000, Heartbeat,
joint-relation contract, exact Taskbook and the Q10/Q18/Q21 scientific
returns used by this audit. The current Taskbook is byte-identical to
the original8254-byte input, blob4d144741f33631ce3d4a70ae5f029712f0ce37bd.
The complete actual readbacks and precise input pins are retained. I read
the relevant upstream signature, morphism and action arguments directly;
I did not use an old DR as an independent decision or authority source.

RR, ER, return and certificate identify the author as EM-P000-79C223;
the publication's publisher is EM-DVR-VPSKLD. The consumed upstream
authors are EM-PHQ10-A61F3C, EM-P000Q18C1-5E7A92 and
EM-PHQ21-7C4E2B. None is my identity or an identity under which I made
a scientific contribution. I did not author Q24, these upstream results,
the original classification table or checker. Root's shared control context
and the known result/metadata summaries were visible. This is directed
NONBLIND review, not blindness or independent historical execution.

I have not executed or imported any old checker, finite enumeration,
prime/sample or Hart work. The arguments below use direct mathematical
reasoning and static source reading. No scientific verifier code or new
research class was needed or run. Hash/readback bookkeeping is not a
replay of the historical experiment.

## 2. The Task's valid negative alternative

The Task asks for source/target types, primitive action, preserved
structure and invertibility for candidate rotation, slice, frame,
relabeling and restriction operations. It explicitly permits the verdict
that the currently declared operations are automorphisms/isomorphisms,
observations rather than Full-model arrows, or underdefined. It forbids
inventing connection/path data before an independently specified arrow.

Section7 of the return names the precise Q24 vocabulary being exhausted:
the listed operations plus the exact Q10 and Q18/Q21 morphism semantics.
This finite vocabulary declaration matters. The proof is a classification
of those supplied operation meanings, rather than an impossibility theorem
over every mathematical function or future P000-compatible law.

Read this way, it is legitimate to return the negative branch instead
of adding arbitrary model changes merely to obtain a path invariant.
Underdefined rotation/time semantics must stay underdefined; a named
operation supplies neither a concrete update nor a theorem that updates
cannot be supplied. The valid terminal strength is the declared-language
audit and the corresponding no-escalation conclusion for the existing
finite hidden-coupling line.

## 3. Current P000 and the philosophical premises are fixed inputs

The current immutable P000 read has SHA256
a49985914104fcbc039436692c18dc78dc2f441919971e99390931ae64504b48.
Heartbeat has SHA256
4b20d874f424815ab5f87de9d76fea9b9879b3f22db7466639e36390bc976c3b,
and joint-relation preservation has SHA256
22e17d9bf7f3cb644f5f91785b8c80f82820462d7ddefc72abf2d1acc7da033b.
The residual-faithful companion was also read, retaining its explicit
distinction between readout compression and actual many-to-one dynamics.

P000 is the assumed native starting point, not an object of proof,
falsification or replacement in this audit. Native space is the six-axis
Heartbeat Cell torsor over signed Z^6, with signed-unit coordinate
adjacency, no distinguished global native origin and a separately typed
time parameter when needed. The exact S6 axis-permutation skeleton is
already defined. Complete rotations beyond that skeleton and detailed
internal/time dynamics remain researchable within the same fixed P000.

Accordingly the historical expressions “Enterprise Plane” and standalone
three-axis native geometry in the Task/return are provenance only. They
must now be read as restricted states or observers inside X6, with a
stated bridge and preserved joint relations. There is no native plane or
independent three-dimensional world, and a selected-coordinate observation
does not prove membership in a three-axis native subtorsor.

The philosophical statements “rotation is primary” and “time records
relational change” guide the research and constrain interpretation. They
do not, without a typed law, determine a unique nonisomorphic update,
irreversibility, connection, curvature or dynamical equation. Conversely,
their lack of a particular update formula is not a proof that a compatible
formula is impossible. This keeps philosophy as an explicit premise and
research direction rather than misusing it as either a completed dynamics
theorem or an occasion to reopen P000.

The old statement that detailed rotation is unresolved must also retain
the already-defined current geometry: it cannot erase the Z^6 Cell
foundation, known coordinate adjacency or exact S6 skeleton. “Bare
rotation underdefined as a general model-change arrow” is a permissible
limited statement; “no exact native rotation semantics exists at all”
would be false at the strength of the known skeleton.

## 4. The finite candidate classifications are correct conditionally

Q10 defines an explicit finite groupoid of framed/PF-10 model reducts.
Its morphisms are, by definition, bijections of the retained sorts that
preserve its listed relations, frame and tensors. They are isomorphisms.
This justifies Q24's classification of those arrows; it does not prove
that all possible arrows in another category must be invertible.

Q18's bridge-free primitive change group is the automorphism group of
its fixed finite hidden/carrier relational witness. Q21 uses its action
on the24-state and6-state choice sets. Those supplied arrows are
automorphisms of that witness and transformations of relation choices.
They do not introduce an independent primitive-data update between
non-equivalent Full models.

Coherent frame changes that transport all relevant primitive and tensor
data produce isomorphic presentations. Primitive-preserving permutations
produce automorphisms; renaming elements while transporting their relations
produces an isomorphic presentation. These qualifications are necessary:
an arbitrary frame replacement with other tensors held fixed need not
be an isomorphism, and an arbitrary permutation need not preserve a
relation. Those would need an explicit new action/preservation law;
the table cannot declare them equivalent merely because they are called
frame change or relabeling.

Slice projection and forgetting have the stated observation/reduct
codomains. An operation with that codomain is not, as typed, an arrow
between two objects in the same Full-model category. A reduct functor
may of course be a legitimate categorical operation in a different
category; Q24 does not prove that such functors or noninvertible maps
are mathematically illegal. It only denies the unproved promotion to a
native Full-model transition.

A time label or family of already specified automorphisms does not
create a primitive-data deformation. The schematic state(t)->state(t+dt)
is not an update law, a physical-time calibration or a seventh spatial
axis. This is a static audit of possible time semantics; no requirement
to add explicit time to every static object follows.

## 5. What Q21 actually closes

For a declared transitive action G on X and a chosen x, a path labelled
by group elements has endpoint equal to their ordered product acting on
x. A loop product is in Stab_G(x), and every stabilizer element is
already a one-arrow loop in the action groupoid. Two endpoint-equal
paths differ by a stabilizer element. Reframing by r conjugates the
stabilizer and its residues. These assertions follow directly from group
action and do not require repeating the old finite enumerations.

Hence a new invariant is not forced by relabeling that fixed group action
as transport. Its existing loop residues can be nontrivial; they are
already part of the static action/isotropy data. Q24 is right to refuse
an independently selected connection, lift comparison or higher cell
merely to evade that exact boundary.

This is not a proof that all native paths carry no further information.
Current P000 explicitly retains ordered native steps, branch identity,
multiplicity and provenance until a safe quotient is established. Paths
E1 then E2 and E2 then E1 can have the same endpoint while remaining
different ordered-path records. Q21's action-groupoid data and its
particular quotient of histories do not classify every such native
record. No blanket prohibition on native path research, holonomy in a
separately specified model or future derived laws is warranted.

## 6. Historical finite models require current typing

The finite Q10 objects have4 or8 opaque Cell labels, graph/incidence
relations and a retained tensor shell. They are not the complete current
native spatial Cell torsor. In particular the current signed-unit Z^6
coordinate adjacency is bipartite: the parity of the sum of coordinates
changes at each unit step. It has no triangle. A literal K4 adjacency
on four vertices therefore cannot be its native coordinate-adjacency
subgraph. This is a typing distinction, not a disproof of P000 or of the
finite graph calculation.

Q10/Q18's group and incidence mathematics may be retained as explicit
external/enriched/restricted relational carriers. A bridge must be
declared and checked before such a relation is claimed to realize current
native spatial adjacency or the complete X6 model. The certificate's
historical FULL_PRIMITIVE_MODEL_WITNESS tag cannot itself provide that
bridge. Its groups S4, order1152 action and finite kernels must not be
promoted to the full native rotation group or P000 ontology.

The64-state calculation also needs this limited interpretation. As a
standalone64-element space it is not a complete Z^6 torsor and is not
a full countermodel of every current P000 axiom. A precise current
bridge for its valid information-loss content is available: choose a
native Cell anchor a, take the static population

    {a+sum_(i=1)^6 epsilon_i E_i : epsilon_i in{0,1}},

and let pi read the first three raw chart coefficients. These are64
distinct Cells inside X6, not64 proposed replacements for the whole
world. The anchor's chart zero is a Cell, not a distinguished global
origin or operational display-origin node. The readout is not a proof
that the observed Cell lies in the three-axis subtorsor.

The readout has8 values,8 preimages each and8*C(8,2)=224 unordered
collision pairs, as claimed. The formulas follow directly from the
three omitted binary coordinates; no enumeration was rerun. Already a
and a+E4 have identical pi readout but different native Cell identities.
Thus the intended noninjectivity claim holds under a stated current
embedding, without asserting binary native coordinates as an axiom.

This is also a concrete joint-preservation boundary. If the future
language includes the current coordinate permutation swapping E1 and
E4, pi of those transformed two Cells differs. The initial pi fiber
therefore is not safe for that future operation. Conversely an observer
quotient may be valid on a smaller explicitly certified operation horizon;
noninjectivity alone is not a universal ban on readout compression.
Actual many-to-one dynamics also remains admissible if separately given
a lawful typed update. Observation loss is not automatically ontic erasure.

## 7. Checker and control evidence do not prove language exhaustion

The checker statically requires the expected nine classification labels
and zero entries labelled NONINVERTIBLE_MODEL_CHANGE_ARROW, then enumerates
the binary coordinate projection and checks its counts. Its candidate
typing checks confirm internal agreement of recorded flags. They do not
derive those flags from a P000 formal semantics, enumerate all definable
functions, or prove that the nine rows exhaust every compositional native
law. The printed native_nonautomorphism_model_change_arrows=0 counts
the supplied classification table, not an independent search theorem.

This limitation is compatible with a declared finite-language audit,
whose semantic classifications must be justified by the written typing
arguments. It rules out using the regression PASS as proof of a stronger
global native absence claim. The return's finite count statements are
correct at the observer scope just described; the absent full-dynamics
signature remains absent rather than supplied by the checker.

The three raw Result enum strings are control compatibility problems.
The existing canonical ER and its CLAIM_INTENT state are provenance
facts; neither its presence nor the old reported checker stdout proves
historical execution authentication or mathematical acceptance. PR1552
and this round's intake are outside the proof. This review neither waits
on them nor treats them as mathematical errors or authority grants.
No field normalization, original-Result rewrite or old-DR inheritance is
performed here.

## 8. Required interpretation and precise remaining obligations

The following restrictions are necessary for a current bounded acceptance:

1. Bind the negative result to Q24's explicitly declared candidate meanings
   and the Q10/Q18/Q21 finite relational semantics. Do not export it as
   absence of all P000-definable or derivable model/state updates.
2. Preserve historical plane, K4 and64-state language only at the
   external/restricted/observer strength above. They do not override or
   replace current native X6 or establish a full-native model bridge.
3. Close only the unsupported escalation of the existing finite
   hidden-coupling action-groupoid transport. Do not erase native ordered
   paths, all possible transport invariants or noninvertible dynamics.
4. Interpret reopening as requiring an exact typed P000-compatible law
   beyond the currently supplied finite action/readout data. Such a law
   may be derived within the fixed P000 foundation; a worldview change
   is neither required nor authorized by Q24. Source/target, primitive
   action, preservation/change and relation to current state/history
   semantics must be explicit before stronger conclusions are drawn.

These are restrictions on what the old result can presently support,
not edits of its immutable science and not a newly invented primitive.
The original Task's frozen-candidate negative alternative is met at this
bounded interpretation. Its broader current-native existence question,
if demanded as a global statement, remains underdefined/unproved and
cannot be marked complete by this report. The larger rotation/tomography
Objective remains open.

The philosophical premises retain their role as native starting axioms
and research commitments. The finite audits give no permission to alter
them, and their non-theorem status as chosen premises does not supply a
missing dynamics theorem. No Foundation/Working Truth/canonical promotion,
new global no-go, physical law, information lower bound or cost result is
claimed.

This report and its fullpin manifest are ready for Root's formal Driver
decision and Source publication. The reviewer makes no remote mutation,
new RA event, Native record, owner, Task, claim, branch or successor here.
Any own-RA checkpoint must follow the actual new Source and preserve all
six existing reviewer events.
